jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT BROCCOLI AI

We work with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors — the people who keep homes running — and we replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with AI agents that actually do the work.

We started by going door-to-door, meeting 100+ contractors, and understanding how these businesses actually run. That shaped everything we’ve built. Today:

 - Hundreds of contractors use Broccoli to run their front office

 - We’ve grown from $0 → millions in ARR in under a year

 - We’re trusted by both single-location operators and the largest PE-backed roll-ups

 - Raised $25M+ from Khosla Ventures and YC

 


THE ROLE

This is one of the highest-impact roles at Broccoli. In this role, you'll shape what we build, in what order, and how successful the rollouts are.

Broccoli is at an exciting growth stage with constant product tradeoffs. New products to build. A steady stream of feature requests from existing customers. Two different customer profiles: enterprise operators and independent SMBs. Plus rapid expansion into new verticals within home services. Every week involves hard calls about what gets built and what doesn't. You'll own those calls day-to-day and help the founders make the bigger strategic ones. When something ships, you own the rollout to customers, the CS team, and the sales team, plus the metrics and the honest answer to whether it actually worked.

We are especially looking for someone who can do two things well. First: get deep into our customers' businesses. We build with design partners, embedding with their teams and truly understanding their businesses. We prioritize based on which AI agents will have the biggest P&L impact for them. Second: know what's possible with AI. Customers ask for what they've seen SaaS products do. You should be building toward what AI makes possible, which is almost always something far better than what anyone thought to request.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Prioritization manage tradeoffs across new products, feature requests, enterprise vs. SMB needs, and expanding verticals; give the team a clear, defensible view of what's most important and why

 - Founder leverage bring enough structure and insight to strategic conversations that the founders can make faster, better decisions on the hard calls

 - Specs and mockups write specs built around the "why" and produce basic mockups that give engineering enough to move fast

 - Launch and go-to-market coordinate with customer success, sales, and marketing when features ship; ensuring the right enablement, release notes, and customer comms are in place

 - Metrics define what success looks like for every feature, ensure the right things get tracked, and review outcomes after every launch

 - AI PM agent build and leverage an agent that ingests tickets, call transcripts, Linear, and product metrics and surfaces what matters most, so your time goes to synthesis and judgment, not information gathering

 


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-haves

 - High-agency: you bring structure to ambiguity, move without being told, and own outcomes end to end

 - Strong business judgment: you get to the real need underneath a customer request and prioritize based on P&L impact, not loudest voice

 - AI-first: you default to asking what's now possible, not what's been done before, and you've built agents or AI-powered workflows yourself

 - Excited to work in-office five days a week to collaborate closely with the founders and the team

Strong plus

 - Former founder, or a PM who has operated like one: you've made calls with incomplete information, owned outcomes, and stayed close to customers throughout

 - Experience at a high-growth B2B startup (Series A to C)

 - Home services or field service management experience

Not a fit

 - PM experience primarily in process management, stakeholder alignment, or sprint facilitation

 - Never owned a product outcome end to end

Broccoli is an equal-opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practice laws.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT BROCCOLI 🥦

We work with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors, the people who keep homes running, and replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with AI agents that actually do the work.

Our AI assistants answer phones, book jobs, follow up with customers, and drive revenue, fully integrated into systems like ServiceTitan.

We started by going door-to-door, meeting 100+ contractors, and understanding how these businesses actually run. That shaped everything we've built. Today:

 - Hundreds of contractors use Broccoli to run their front office

 - We've grown from $0 to millions in ARR in under a year

 - We're trusted by both single-location operators and the largest PE-backed roll-ups

 - We've raised $25M+ from Khosla Ventures and Y Combinator




THE ROLE

We're seeking an experienced Product Marketer to own the foundational product messaging and positioning that drives Broccoli's product innovations and launch strategy.

Reporting into the CEO, this is a foundational, high-ownership role. You'll be the second PMM at Broccoli, which means you're not stepping into a pre-built playbook, you're writing it. You'll work directly with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and other GTM teams to shape how the market understands Broccoli, build the materials that help our team win deals, and launch new features in a way that creates real market impact.

If you thrive in ambiguity, love learning how things work, and can translate complexity into clarity, this is your role.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Create clear product messaging - help everyone at Broccoli talk about our products in the same way and make complex features easy to understand for different audiences

 - Help shape what we build - work with product to decide which features matter most and figure out how to position them in the market

 - Launch products that get noticed

 - Develop buyer insights

 - Enable sales teams - create training programs, sales assets, and enablement materials that help reps have better conversations and close more deals

 - Drive customer expansion - help existing customers grow their usage and increase their investment in Broccoli

 - Build customer advocacy

 - Build systems that work as we grow - simple, repeatable processes for launches and releases that won't break as the team gets bigger

 - Keep teams aligned - ensure Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success are all on the same page about what we're launching and why




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 4-8 years of product marketing experience at high-growth B2B SaaS companies

 - Success leading cross-functional teams across Marketing, Product, and GTM

 - Building and scaling processes in a dynamic startup environment

 - Deep experience partnering with Product teams on messaging, positioning, and bringing products to market alongside Marketing and Sales teams

 - Revenue-focused mindset: Strong understanding of customer buying processes, sales processes, revenue expansion, and the ability to diagnose and optimize a revenue funnel

 - Proven track record as a trusted partner to GTM leaders in building revenue foundations and driving growth initiatives

 - Exceptional communication skills and the ability to translate complex concepts into simple frameworks and ideas through written and visual presentations

 - Creative problem solving to drive business outcomes through first principles thinking and creative solutions

 - Thrives in ambiguous environments and excellence navigating fast-moving, early-stage environments

 - Experimentation mindset to utilize AI tools to optimize and scale Product Marketing workflows

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT BROCCOLI AI

At Broccoli, we're building AI teammates for the people who build and maintain our world.

We partner with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors, the hardworking businesses that keep homes and communities running, and replace fragmented software and repetitive manual work with AI that actually gets the job done.

Our AI teammates answer phones, book appointments, follow up with customers, recover missed revenue, and help contractors deliver exceptional customer experiences, all while integrating seamlessly with platforms like ServiceTitan.

Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built.

Today:

 - Hundreds of contractors rely on Broccoli every day.

 - We've grown to $15M+ ARR in under two years.

 - We're trusted by everyone from independent contractors to some of the largest private equity backed operators in the home services industry.

 - We're backed by Khosla Ventures and Y Combinator.

We're still just getting started.



The role

We're hiring a Product Manager to take full ownership of one of Broccoli's core product lines, guiding it from early discovery all the way through deployment.

This isn't a generalist role. You'll go deep on a specific product area, working hands-on with engineering and design, and directly with customers, to figure out what needs to be built, why it matters, and how to ship it in a way that scales. You'll be the link between customer reality and engineering execution, taking in feedback from CSMs, TAMs, and customers and turning it into clear, actionable requirements the team can build against.

The right person for this role is deeply invested in the long-term health of the product, not just keeping any one customer happy in the moment. You build quickly, think in systems, and know how to turn ambiguity into a clear direction forward.


What you'll own

 - Full ownership of a product area, from initial concept through launch, including the roadmap for the foundational capabilities that fuel our next generation of AI agents.

 - Partner directly with customers to identify new opportunities for AI to reshape their workflows, enable automation, and improve their overall experience.

 - Build tools that give contractors real control over how their AI agents handle calls, bookings, and follow-ups, tailored to their specific trade, service area, and way of doing business.

 - Turn promising ideas into well-defined product specs, then collaborate with engineering and design to bring them to life, from launch through iteration.


Who we're looking for

Must-haves

 - High-agency: you bring structure to ambiguity, move without being told, and own outcomes end to end

 - Strong business judgment: you get to the real need underneath a customer request and prioritize based on P&L impact, not loudest voice

 - AI-first: you default to asking what's now possible, not what's been done before, and you've built agents or AI-powered workflows yourself

 - Excited to work in-office five days a week to collaborate closely with the founders and the team

Strong plus

 - Former founder, or a PM who has operated like one: you've made calls with incomplete information, owned outcomes, and stayed close to customers throughout

 - Experience at a high-growth B2B startup (Series A to C)

 - Home services or field service management experience

Not a fit

 - PM experience primarily in process management, stakeholder alignment, or sprint facilitation

 - Never owned a product outcome end to end

Broccoli is an equal-opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practice laws.
